speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To help you with your acute diarrhea, could you please describe exactly what your symptoms are and how long you have been experiencing them? Also, have you had a fever or noticed any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection.

Based on your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the development of severe watery diarrhea, this is highly suggestive of antibiotic-associated colitis. I need to confirm your current vital signs, specifically your temperature and heart rate, and perform a digital rectal exam to check for tenderness or blood.
